mapper.select: SELECT id, timestamp, action, description, username, ip_address AS ipAddress, user_agent AS userAgent, http_method AS httpMethod, request_path AS requestPath, parameters, result, status, error_message AS errorMessage, class_name AS className, method_name AS methodName, duration_ms AS durationMs FROM audit_logs WHERE action LIKE 'LOGIN%' AND status = 'FAILURE' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM audit_logs WHERE timestamp < #{timestamp} LIMIT 10000
